gloss: to insist on having one's own way

definitions.gloss: to insist on having one's own way; to be obstinate
definitions.explanation: To hold stubbornly to one's own opinion or wishes and refuse to give way to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{我|が}を{張|は}らないで。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{我|が}を{張|は}り⟦{通|とお}した→通す：02300_toosu⟧。
examples.english: He insisted on his own way to the very end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧とも{我|が}を{張|は}って⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{進|すす}まなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Both of them kept insisting on their own way, so the discussion made no progress at all.

notes:
⟦{我|が}→我：28333_ga⟧ here means one's ego or self-will; ⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ means to stretch it out and hold it firm. Godan verb phrase: {我|が}を{張|は}らない, {我|が}を{張|は}って.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {我|が}を{張|は}り⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧: to insist on one's own way to the end
- {我|が}を{張|は}らず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without being stubborn
- {我|が}が⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: self-willed, headstrong

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意地|いじ}を{張|は}る→意地を張る：15442_ijiwoharu⟧: to be stubborn out of pride, refusing to back down; {我|が}を{張|は}る stresses pushing one's own wishes over others'
- ⟦{強情|ごうじょう}→強情：18243_goujou⟧: obstinate (na-adjective)
